verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk data export, open-format download, or data-portability and offboarding feature. The only related items are individual read endpoints: listing customers and fetching filings. These are developer building blocks a user could use to assemble a partial export, not an export capability, and nothing shows transactions, certificates, or other records can be retrieved in full.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
